design_method: Independently authored discrete pin-grid design; not an automatic conversion from a paper export.
data_pins_encoding: 40 row-major strings of 0/1 separated by a single ASCII space; first row is the top row; first column is left. 1=raised, 0=lowered.
svg_representation: One black rect per raised pin, width=1 height=1 at integer x,y. No background drawing element; no grayscale, variable stroke weights, visible text or Braille.
review: Digital shape/meaning/grid inspection is required for each exported design; actual device and touch evaluation remains pending.
pin_spacing_status: Unconfirmed. No physical millimetre spacing assumed. Design assumes equal horizontal/vertical unit pin pitch only; verify physical pitch with Dot.
separate_braille_line: 20-cell text line excluded from graphics grid.
grid_basis: 60 x 40 graphics pins required by the supplied integration instruction.
